ACME CORPORATION — ENTERPRISE SECURITY POLICY
Document ID: SEC-POL-2025-001 | Effective: January 1, 2025

Least privilege and zero trust are required enterprise security policy principles.

SCOPE
This policy applies to all employees, contractors, and third parties accessing ACME systems.

SECURITY PRINCIPLES
Least privilege and zero trust are required enterprise security policy principles.
Defense in depth, least privilege, and zero trust for all internal and external access.
All systems must maintain audit logs retained for 90 days.

ACCEPTABLE USE
Personal use of company systems must not interfere with business operations.
Installing unapproved software is prohibited.

DATA PROTECTION
Confidential data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.
USB storage devices are blocked on workstations handling sensitive data.

CONTACT: security@acme-corp.com | SOC Hotline: ext. 9911
